answer: To register, an agent locks a dual-asset bond, half token and half stablecoin as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Caught running a cluster of identities off one wallet, the fault is proven by graph analysis of funding flows. The penalty follows at once: the offender must re-bond at double the amount to return. Each bond sits in its own forge, seizable in one transaction. The relic stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. Each fake needs its own island, and each island costs a full bond.
